verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The change correctly centralizes workflow `if:` presence/value reading and the canonical default-branch expression without weakening the workflow-specific exact-match assertions. The shared reader preserves the important distinction between a missing guard and declared false/None values, normalizes only representation-level whitespace for the guards in scope, and fails closed for malformed nodes. The three consumers retain separate presence and exact-value findings; the sweep-only schedule carve-out remains local and exact. The added tests exercise missing, neutered, malformed, widened, reordered, and reflowed conditions, verify consumer delegation to the shared implementation, restore sentinels with `finally`, cover the entry point, and enroll the new module in the self-test suite. I found no correctness, soundness, test-vacuity, or security blocker in the diff.
